next_action.description: Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-361/brief.md end to end - it holds the entire settled design. Then start Phase A with the SAFEST piece first: add the mask-points branch to comfy_workflows/raw/img_auto_mask.json (MaskToSEGS combined=False, drop_size 1 -> SAMDetectorCombined detection_hint='mask-points', threshold 0.93, dilation 0 -> GrowMaskWithBlur expand -4 -> GrowMaskWithBlur expand +4 fill_holes true), keeping the existing YOLO detector path intact and gated beside it. Re-sync with scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs (ComfyUI must be running on 127.0.0.1:8188) and confirm 0 dangling links and 0 missing-required inputs. Only then touch MaskManager and the UI.

key_decisions: PHASE A FIRST, PHASE B AFTER. Phase A = Impact Pack Mask Pointer on the sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth weight the auto-mask graph ALREADY loads. Zero download, zero licence, zero dependency entry. Phase B = swap SAM3_Detect in behind the same UI for a 1.75GB checkpoint, as its own card, only once A is user-verified.

The chain is MaskToSEGS(combined=False, drop_size 1) -> SAMDetectorCombined(detection_hint='mask-points'). detection_hint MUST be 'mask-points'. Every other hint crops per-seg and would cage SAM inside a tiny box around the dot.
threshold IS the confidence dial the user remembered from the old ComfyUI Preview Bridge SAM detector. Confirmed by the user.
dilation STAYS AT 0. The user verified on the bench that it grows into unwanted areas because it is a blind dilate of whatever SAM returned, scatter included. The eraser brush is the better answer.
The BROAD/0.50 branch was DROPPED. Tight (0.93) is enough.
NO slider remapping and NO MpiNormalizeValue rig. The user proposed then retracted it. Ship the raw threshold plus an info box - users learn tools fast.

Scatter cleanup = morphological open then close, 2 KJNodes, no new weights: GrowMaskWithBlur(expand=-4) then GrowMaskWithBlur(expand=+4, fill_holes=true). The pair MUST stay equal and opposite or the mask grows or shrinks overall. 4/4 is the shipping default. USER-CONFIRMED on the bench that it closes the holes.

Add / Subtract is APP-SIDE, not graph-side. MaskManager already keeps manualCanvas (paint), subtractCanvas (erase) and derives maskCanvas = (manual union autoPickMasks) AND NOT subtract. So Add = draw the returned mask into manualCanvas, Subtract = draw it into subtractCanvas. No AddMask/SubtractMask nodes, no extra round-trip per boolean, undo preserved, composes with the existing brush.
The old YOLO detector path is KEPT as a fast one-click Face / Hair / Hand / Person shortcut. Points sit BESIDE it, they do not replace it.
Shape masking (rectangle / triangle / ellipse gizmo) was split out to MPI-368, not part of this card.
constraints: N DOTS DO NOT GIVE N OBJECTS. In the mask-points branch every point goes into ONE sam_obj.predict call, so SAM returns a SINGLE region consistent with ALL points. Bench-confirmed: one dot on a crop top = the top alone; top dot + pants dot = the WHOLE BODY. Phase A is genuinely ONE PART PER RUN. The info box must say so plainly or users will keep adding dots expecting more parts and get less.

SAMDetectorSegmented has the BYTE-IDENTICAL mask-points branch, so it is not an escape hatch for multi-object. Only the center-1 else-branch loops per-seg, but it passes each dot's own bbox as SAM's box constraint, so a 16px dot boxes SAM into 16px unless bbox_expansion is cranked - which reintroduces the exact crop ceiling mask-points was chosen to avoid. Multi-object-per-run is PARKED as an unbuilt experiment.

threshold is NOT a smooth confidence. sam_predict keeps every SAM candidate mask scoring >= threshold and unions them, falling back to the single highest-scoring mask if none pass. SAM emits 3 candidates (part / subpart / whole), so the dial SNAPS between 3 states. 0.50 -> 0.60 is usually identical. The user hit this and thought it was broken. Sweep it, do not nudge it, and say so in the info box.
In the mask-points branch SAM runs ONCE over the FULL image with bbox=None, so crop_factor does NOT cage a tiny dot. This was the main technical risk and it is dead.

Negative-point cutoff is EXACT: with mask_hint_use_negative='Small', a dot whose bbox width is < 10 px becomes plab=0 (negative). Brush size is the polarity switch. A 10px cliff is poor UX - prefer two explicit point layers in our own UI and synthesise the dot sizes when building the mask we send.

Scatter is not cosmetic. The detailer masks each zone INDIVIDUALLY, so a stray speck buys a wasted detail pass. The user reports the same failure on the existing detect-person path, so the cleanup pair fixes both.
MPI-246 trap: if any newly-added node self-builds its path enum, it must be added to SLASH_ONLY_NODE_TYPES (docs/comfy.md). This broke auto-mask on a released build before.

Shipped 1.2.0 contract: the auto-mask workflow MUST emit one mask per pick via ImpactSEGSToMaskList, never SegsToCombinedMask. The JS guards on length === picks.size and a combined mask wipes multi-pick.
LoadImage's MASK output is 1 - alpha, so a painted point is alpha 0. Only relevant to the probe graph's baked demo dot; MaskEditor handles it correctly on its own.
MpiLoadImageFromPath emits a preview image into the prompt outputs map. A result reader that grabs the first outputs entry picks up the INPUT, not the result. Key by node id.
Masks persist as TEMP PNGs per (project, group, item) - they survive reload but die on restart. A committed points result is a normal mask edit, nothing special.
The app's own engine runs on 127.0.0.1:8188 from engine/ComfyUI_windows_portable. scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs needs it UP to resolve widget names from /object_info.
Do not run git against sibling folders from this repo, and commit by explicit pathspec only - never git add -A.
